title: Touch_ST7123 getTouchRaw() parses uninitialised buffers after a failed I2C read (code-level)

hardware.reason: No Tab5 attached to this workspace; no I2C fault injection on real hardware.

firmware.target: M5Stack Tab5, ST7121 panel, touch FW version 01 (reporter's unit, not tested here)

execution.virtual_device: NOT RUN: the local Tab5 emulator has no ST7123 controller-level model; no forced I2C read failure

checks.name: source review of getTouchRaw() read handling
checks.details: All three _readParams() results ignored; adv_info and touch_report[] uninitialised at Touch_ST7123.inl:132-141.

checks.name: I2C failure semantics of _readParams()/transactionWriteRead()
checks.details: readBytes() writes each received byte and returns connection_lost on NACK/timeout; buffer untouched or partially filled.

checks.name: 0.2.28 vs 0.3.0 getTouchRaw() body comparison
checks.details: Identical function body; 0.2.28 uses Touch_ST7123.cpp, master uses Touch_ST7123.inl.

checks.name: host reproduction: report read fails with untouched buffer
checks.details: master returns 5 phantom touches (id=0 x=16383 y=65535 size=255); proposed patch returns 0.

checks.name: host reproduction: report read fails after 3 bytes
checks.details: master returns 4 phantom touches (first at id=1); proposed patch returns 0.

checks.name: host reproduction: no failure / adv_info failure / max_touches failure
checks.details: Both master and patched versions return 0, matching the reporter's results.

checks.name: host check of _read_fw_info() failure return
checks.details: All three reads fail -> returns 1, so init() reports success with no responding chip.

checks.name: physical Tab5 I2C fault injection / soak
virtual-device reproduction in esp-emulator/QEMU
checks.details: No ST7123 controller-level model; forcing one read failure not attempted.

checks.name: full M5GFX/firmware build and panel regression with the patch
effect of the patch on the #418 ghost contacts
checks.details: Reporter states the two issues are independent; not evaluated here.

checks.name: upstream comment
checks.details: Posted one English comment at https://github.com/m5stack/M5GFX/issues/417#issuecomment-6904990572; issue left open, no code pushed.

notes: Read-only review: no M5GFX change, no push to the upstream repository, no issue close.
Host reproduction is code-level verification, not device validation.
Phantom coordinates depend on stack contents; only the 'uninitialised data is parsed' conclusion is portable.
